    def uses_arrayset(stmts: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> bool:
        n = len(stmts)
        i = 0
        #@ loop invariant 0 <= i and i <= n
        #@ loop variant n - i
        while i < n:
            stmt = stmts[i]
            if stmt.get("stmt") == "ArraySet":
                return True
            keys = ["body", "orelse"]
            j = 0
            #@ loop invariant 0 <= j and j <= 2
            #@ loop variant 2 - j
            while j < 2:
                key = keys[j]
                if key in stmt and IRScanner.uses_arrayset(stmt[key]):
                    return True
                j += 1
            i += 1
        return False
